body: I strain my eyes, peering into the darkness, my heart pounding in my chest. The silence is oppressive, punctuated only by the distant calls of animals. My skin crawls with every snap of a twig, every rustle of leaves. I slow my pace, focusing on the trees ahead, and notice a faint trail of disturbed earth, leading away from the darkness. I quicken my steps, weaving in and out of the trees, keeping a watchful eye on the shadows. My thoughts are consumed by the unknown creature, my mind racing with worst-case scenarios.
